title: Vitest, Jest and Playwright
description: Conventions for Vitest, Jest and Playwright.

rules.title: Colocated unit tests
rules.text: Colocate unit tests as *.test.ts next to the code they cover.

rules.title: Playwright for E2E
rules.text: Write end-to-end tests with Playwright, using role and text locators rather than CSS selectors.

rules.title: No fixed waits
rules.text: Never use fixed sleeps in tests; wait on conditions or web-first assertions.

rules.title: Mock network at the edge
rules.text: Mock network calls at the network layer (for example MSW) instead of mocking fetch internals.
